crossRefs.note: There was a man in the land of Uz, whose name was Job. That man was blameless and upright, and one who feared God, and…
so am I made to possess months of misery, wearisome nights are appointed to me.
Haven’t you made a hedge around him, and around his house, and around all that he has, on every side? You have blessed…
For Yahweh loves justice, and doesn’t forsake his saints. They are preserved forever, but the children of the wicked…
Jude, a servant of Jesus Christ, and brother of James, to those who are called, sanctified by God the Father, and kept…

translations.web: “Oh that I were as in the months of old, as in the days when God watched over me;
translations.bsb: “How I long for the months gone by, for the days when God watched over me,
translations.kjv: Oh that I were as in months past, as in the days when God preserved
